decisionsTitle: A volunteer says their age, sex, city and experience; the role has a rich description, translated; the tick boxes
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-14, from his phone:** «când se înregistrează voluntarul trebuie să pună măcar vârstă, sex, oraș și o bifă dacă a mai fost voluntar sau nu și opțional (configurabil) bifă pentru tricou (acum nu vom da tricouri)»; «Și bifă dacă e din „Brașov Runners” grup»; «Aici la rol trebuie să avem și descriere»; «I need to be able to translate the Volunteer roles and I need the rich text editor here for responsibilities»; «Și vreau și o bifă cu „am mai fost voluntar în trecut la alte curse”»; and, as a standing rule (memory owner-no-toggle-buttons), «nu mai folosi niciodată acest tip de element» for a button that flips a setting. Amends §754 (volunteers), §758 (the agreement) and §761 (several roles).

**Decision.**

- **What the volunteer says.** The public form «Vreau să fiu voluntar» asks, besides the name, the address and the telephone number: **«Vârsta»** (whole years, required), **«Sex»** (required — the registration form's own `SexField`, its two answers and its words), **«Orașul»** (one short line, required), the optional tick **«Am mai fost voluntar în trecut la alte curse»** (unticked is «nu», not unknown), the optional tick **«Fac parte din grupul {club}»** (the club's name from `CLUB_NAME`, never a literal, §357; the person's own claim, checked against nothing — like the registration form's member tick) and **«Mărimea tricoului»**, only while the event's new switch **«Oferim tricouri voluntarilor»** is on (off by default: «acum nu vom da tricouri»). Stored on `event_volunteers` (`age`, `sex`, `city`, `volunteered_before`, `club_member`, `shirt_size`) and `events.volunteers_shirts`; a row from before holds nulls and false. The service validates the same; the form works with scripts off and keeps what was typed after a refusal.
- **The age answers «Am cel puțin 18 ani».** `VOLUNTEER_MINIMUM_AGE` stays 18 (the minimum age 14 and a guardian's consent are the next lane, not this one), now checked against the typed age: a number below it is refused with «Voluntarii trebuie să aibă cel puțin 18 ani», anything that is not a number with «Scrie vârsta în ani întregi». The tick «Am cel puțin 18 ani» goes from the public form because the age answers it; it stays on the single-use link's page (§758), where no age is typed. The sex asked here is the registration form's, and the retired `UNSPECIFIED` is never written.
- **Does the notice have to name them first? Yes — the §562 / §613 pattern.** The age, the sex and the city are new personal data, and the notice in force is the only text that tells a person what is kept and why. The privacy notice's TEMPLATE gets its own marker `{{volunteerProfile}}` in the volunteers' paragraph (the form's boxes by their labels, quoted; the club-group tick and the T-shirt are said in the paragraph's own words, never quoted, so the approved text never names the club; the size only while the club gives T-shirts; the age stands in for the age statement; purpose: to organize the volunteers). Until a notice that names it is in force in every language, the public form is §758's — the tick, no age, sex or city, nothing kept — and `/admin/tasks` carries the row `volunteerProfileNotice`; the card says so in a line. The texts in force never move: the club approves the new notice, and the §639 email tells the Administrators the template changed. A lawyer reads whether the sex, which the registration form also asks, needs more than the purpose written there.
- **The organizers' side.** Adding or changing a volunteer by hand takes the same boxes, all optional (an age below the minimum is refused) — and, like the public form, only while the notice in force names `{{volunteerProfile}}`: the card draws them then and `changeVolunteer` refuses a post that sets one otherwise (a post with none leaves what the row holds); the template's sentence says so (the answers an organizer notes for a person they enter); the card's row shows two small chips — «A mai fost voluntar» and «Din grupul {club}» — and one line of the rest (age, sex, city and, while the event gives T-shirts, the size); the CSV gains six columns after the moment (age, sex in the registrations' own words, city, the two ticks as «Da»/«Nu», the size — empty unless the event gives T-shirts); «Toate datele unei persoane» lists every field. Retention is unchanged: thirty days after the event (§754). A size left on a row after the switch comes off is shown and exported nowhere.
- **«Oferim tricouri voluntarilor»** is the same tick as «Primește voluntari pe pagină» (a submit drawn as the checkbox, one press, no «Salvează»), with a one-line help, in the «Voluntari» card; the event editor's save never writes it and a copy of an event never inherits it. It is audited (`event.volunteers_shirts_switched`).
- **«Primește voluntari pe pagină» becomes a real tick box.** It was a submit button with a turn-on / turn-off glyph; it is now the to-do tick's pattern (§752): a plain form whose submit is drawn as the checkbox, `role="checkbox"` with `aria-checked`, its words beside it, 44 pixels, the state in the glyph as well as the colour, working with scripts off — the same action behind it.
- **«Descrierea rolului».** «Ce face persoana» (one line of 200 characters) is replaced by the house rich-text editor, one document per language, both languages or neither, about 2000 characters of plain words each (lists and paragraphs, no tables or pictures), stored the FAQ's way: the document (`description_ro_json`, `description_en_json`) and its plain words (`description_words_ro`, `description_words_en`, written by every save through `richTextToPlainText`). Shown under each role's tick on the public form (`RichText`, folded «Detalii» when longer than about three lines or 120 characters (about three lines at 320 pixels), the role's tick naming the description in `aria-describedby`), on the card's role header (the first line of the plain words, the rest folded), and — as the plain words — in the agreement's «Ce presupune rolul», its PDF and the emails. The migration `0151` backfills an existing one-line description into a one-paragraph document (proven in PGlite); the old `description_ro` / `description_en` columns stay, untouched and unread, until a later contract release.
- **Translate.** The role's own form (add and edit) carries the house «Copiază și tradu tot: RO → EN» (§464, §482): `nameEn` from `nameRo` as text, the English description from the Romanian as HTML with the layout kept; greyed with the steps' link while `TRANSLATE_PROVIDER` is off, like the editor's.

**Refused.** A second vocabulary for sex or sizes (the registration form's are reused); two radios for «Am mai fost voluntar» (one tick, unticked is no); checking the club-group tick against «Echipa» (it is the person's claim); a hidden toggle button for either switch (the standing rule); editing the texts in force from the code.
changelogLine: - **Volunteers give their age, sex, city and experience; the role has a rich description** — the sign-up asks «Vârsta» (18 or more), «Sex», «Orașul», «Am mai fost voluntar în trecut la alte curse», «Fac parte din grupul clubului» and, only while the event gives them, the T-shirt's size, once the notice in force names them; the card, the CSV and the person's data carry the answers; a role's «Descrierea rolului» is written in the rich-text editor in both languages, with «Copiază și tradu tot», and read under its tick; «Primește voluntari pe pagină» and «Oferim tricouri voluntarilor» are real tick boxes. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criteria 33 and 35. Given an event that takes volunteers and a privacy notice in force, in every language, that names `{{volunteerProfile}}`, when a visitor opens «Vreau să fiu voluntar», then the form asks «Vârsta» (whole years, at least 18 — 17 is refused with «Voluntarii trebuie să aibă cel puțin 18 ani», a non-number with «Scrie vârsta în ani întregi»), «Sex» (the registration form's two answers), «Orașul» (one line, at most 80 characters), the optional ticks «Am mai fost voluntar în trecut la alte curse» and «Fac parte din grupul» with the club's name from its settings (unticked is false), and «Mărimea tricoului» only while the event's «Oferim tricouri voluntarilor» is on, and no longer the tick «Am cel puțin 18 ani»; the service validates the same and keeps the answers, the size only while the event gives T-shirts; the form works with scripts off and keeps what was typed after a refusal; while the notice does not name them the form is the earlier one, with its tick, and nothing of this is kept (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 120, 121 and 136. Given the event's «Voluntari» card, then «Primește voluntari pe pagină» is a form whose submit is drawn as a checkbox (`role="checkbox"`, `aria-checked`, its words beside it, at least 44 pixels, working with scripts off) and «Oferim tricouri voluntarilor» is the same tick, one press and no «Salvează» (off by default, audited, never written by the editor's save); a person entered by hand or changed takes the age (below 18 refused), sex, city, the two ticks and, while the event gives T-shirts, the size, all optional and drawn and kept only while the notice in force names `{{volunteerProfile}}` (otherwise the service refuses a post that sets one); each row shows the chips «A mai fost voluntar» and «Din grupul» with the club's name, and one line of the rest; the CSV has the six columns after the moment; and «Toate datele unei persoane» lists every field (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 121. Given a volunteer role, when it is added or changed, then «Descrierea rolului» is a rich-text document per language, both languages or neither, with its plain words (at most 2000 characters, written by every save) beside it; it is shown under the role's tick on the public form (folded «Detalii» past about three lines), on the card's role header (the first line, the rest folded) and, as plain words, in the agreement's «Ce presupune rolul», its PDF and the emails; the role's form carries «Copiază și tradu tot: RO → EN» filling the English name and description (greyed with the steps while the translation is off); and migration `0151_volunteer_profile_fields` is expand-only — it adds the role's four description columns (backfilling each non-empty one-line description into a one-paragraph document), the volunteer's six answer columns and `events.volunteers_shirts`, and drops nothing (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 65. Given the privacy notice's template, then the volunteers' paragraph names the age, the sex, the city, whether the person has volunteered before, their own claim to belong to the club's group and, only while the club gives T-shirts, the size, with the purpose, under its own marker `{{volunteerProfile}}`, covering also the answers an organizer notes for a person they enter; the texts in force never move, `/admin/tasks` carries the row `volunteerProfileNotice` until a notice that names it is in force in every language, and the public form and the organizers' entry take those boxes only while it is (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: volunteers give their age, sex, city and experience; the role's description
